about.what: Per-country subscription prices for Sweden, Norway and Denmark, checked by hand-run scripts on official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-2026-11.json and prices-mena-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: amountMinor is in the currency's minor unit (öre for SEK, øre for NOK and DKK). 14900 = 149.00 kr. Oura rows for SE and DK are in EUR cents because Oura bills EU members in euros. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'.
status.partial: Some plans read from the official page; others missing (see note).
status.unverified: Read from an official list but the amount is ambiguous, or not read from an official page. Don't ship without checking.

about.taxes: Sweden, Norway and Denmark all have 25% VAT. Apple's iCloud+ table says taxes are included for all three; apple.com and App Store prices include VAT. Netflix's help page says taxes 'may be charged in addition' and doesn't say if VAT is included. Other service pages don't say either way.
about.serviceIds: serviceId and plan ids match the shared plan reference (same plan = same id in every country). Plan names are the names shown on the local page or App Store list.
about.method: Service pages read with curl or Playwright (chromium) from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. spotify.com/se/premium, playstation.com/da-dk/ps-plus). App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items). Pages that pick the country or currency from the visitor's IP (canva.com, primevideo.com) or that blocked the script (amazon.se, github.com, docs.midjourney.com) could not be read.

notChecked.apple-news: Apple News+ isn't sold in Sweden, Norway or Denmark: apple.com/se, /no and /dk/apple-news/ all return 404.
notChecked.apple-fitness: DK: not sold in Denmark. apple.com/dk/apple-fitness-plus/ returns 404, and the country list on the Swedish and Norwegian Fitness+ pages doesn't include Denmark.
notChecked.amazon-prime: SE: amazon.se returned 503 to our script for every Prime and help page, so no price was read. NO, DK: there's no Amazon store with Prime for these countries.
notChecked.prime-video: Standalone Prime Video in NO/DK is sold on primevideo.com, which picks the country from the visitor's IP, and the App Store page shows no In-App Purchases list. Not checked.
notChecked.amazon-music: SE: amazon.se blocked (503); the App Store list shows 'Individual' at two prices (115 kr and 119 kr) with no hint which is the Prime price. NO, DK: the Amazon Music app isn't on these App Stores (404).
notChecked.audible: No Audible store for Sweden, Norway or Denmark. The App Store list only shows other countries' plans priced in kronor (e.g. 'UK Premium Monthly', 'US Premium Monthly', 'DE - Audible iOS Monthly'), so there's no clear local price.
notChecked.canva-pro: canva.com/pricing shows US$ to our cloud browser (picks currency from IP). The App Store list shows 'Canva Pro - Monthly' at several prices (SE 119/120/150 kr, NO 109/200 kr, DK 85/110 kr) and 'Canva Pro - Yearly' at several too. No clear price.
notChecked.nintendo-online: nintendo.se, nintendo.no and nintendo.dk Switch Online pages describe the memberships but show no prices (the nintendo.com/<lang>-<cc> URLs used elsewhere don't exist for these countries). Prices are only shown in the eShop.
notChecked.oura: NO: the membership page has no Norway or EEA row. Norway isn't in the EU, so it most likely falls under 'rest of world' ($6.99 USD/month or $79.00 USD/year), but the page doesn't say so outright.
notChecked.uber-one: NO: uber.com/no/en/u/uber-one/ says 'we can't find your page'. Uber One doesn't seem to be offered in Norway.
